services.name: 3 Hour Private Custom Charter
services.desc: Experience The Magic Of Kauai's Waters, Tailored To You About At Po'ipu Offshore Adventures, we offer private charter experiences for up to 6 guests, allowing flexibility to tailor your custom offshore adventure. Specializing in south shore snorkeling and sightseeing, as well as seasonal whale watching (December-March) our 3 hour charters run three times a day for convenience and efficiency. We strive to provide the ultimate offshore experience and share the magic of Kauai's waters with our guests. We are looking forward to meeting you. services.name: Fishing Charter
services.desc: Let's make this fishing adventure the highlight of your vacation! Tour Time & Duration 4, 6 and 8 hour charter options 6:30am departure About Come out with us to target some of the most desirable game fish in the world. From offshore species, such as ahi, ono, mahi mahi and marlin, to the brutes of the reef such as the giant trevally, great amberjack, barracuda and more. Our vessel’s versatility allows us to mix it up to get you in on the action. 4 Hour Charter: Our 4 hour charter allows you to get a taste of offshore fishing without spending the whole day on the water. 6 Hour Charter: Our 6 hour fishing charter (our most popular) gives us the time to get out to the prized fishing grounds.

services.name: Napali Coast Adventure *April-September
services.desc: About Tour Time & Duration 8 hour charter 7:00 departure Looking for a true offshore adventure? Cruise along the forgotten south shore en route to the majestic Napali Coast. On this tour we’re bound to find the playful Hawaiian Spinner Dolphins as they frolic in the calm west side waters. Once on the Napali Coast, we’ll explore the towering sea cliffs, lush and sheer valleys and canyons, zip into sea caves and snorkel at the base of a soaring cliffside while looking for the resident sea turtles and endangered monk seals.
